name: platform-auth-rate-limit-isolation
description: platform-auth: only the rate-limit Sub_Module owns lockout counters; consumers must call exported helpers, not import internals.

name: platform-auth-store-isolation
description: platform-auth: storeWriteLocks lives in store.ts; other Sub_Modules use withPlatformAuthStoreWriteLock and accessors.

name: platform-auth-facade-direction
description: platform-auth facade: re-exports only; must not pull from sibling gateway modules.

name: collaboration-learning-state-machine-isolation
description: collaboration-learning: state-machine internals are private; consumers go through event-entry.

name: collaboration-learning-snapshot-isolation
description: collaboration-learning: snapshot building stays inside evaluation-aggregation.

name: loader-runtime-resolve-isolation
description: plugins/loader: jiti and plugin-sdk alias setup is owned by runtime-resolve; other Sub_Modules use the exported getJiti().

name: loader-no-deep-discovery-import
description: plugins/loader: must use the discovery facade, not deep-import its internals.

name: hooks-no-import-hook-runner-global
description: plugins/hooks: keeps the boundary one-directional with hook-runner-global to prevent the previously-flagged circular import.

name: channels-no-plugin-sdk-facade
description: channels own their implementations. plugin-sdk is a re-export facade and must not be imported by core channel code.

name: shared-package-matrix-no-gateway
description: The shared package matrix is a leaf. SeatRole lives in src/shared/seat-role.ts so billing can depend on it.

name: utils-usage-format-no-upper-layers
description: Usage formatting accepts structural cost and usage shapes and does not import agents or config.

name: hooks-event-family-isolation
description: plugins/hooks: event-family files must not depend on each other; the runner is the only assembler.

name: agent-runtime-context-assembly-isolation
description: Pure context assembly cannot invoke runtime, task mutations, tools or scheduling; sources remain injected values.

name: agent-runtime-contracts-pure-data
description: Cross-layer contracts own types only; they cannot depend on runtime implementations or persistence.

name: runtime-command-no-direct-execution
description: Command use cases cannot directly invoke models, tools, scheduling or task persistence; effects use explicit injected ports and pure projections.

name: runtime-command-auto-reply-public-entry
description: Production entrances must use the explicit command facade, not individual use-case internals.

name: runtime-command-gateway-public-entry
description: Production entrances must use the explicit command facade, not individual use-case internals.

name: runtime-recovery-no-state-side-effects
description: Bounded recovery owns loop sequencing only, not persistence, transport, task completion or scheduling.

name: runtime-recovery-public-entry
description: Legacy runner and adapters consume the explicit execution facade, not recovery internals.

name: runtime-preparation-no-execution-effects
description: Legacy parameter preparation may inherit trusted identity but cannot invoke providers, task mutations or scheduling.

name: runtime-preparation-public-entry
description: Existing reply adapters use the explicit preparation API, not its implementation.

name: runtime-delivery-no-task-control
description: Candidate delivery preparation cannot mutate tasks, invoke model runners or schedule recovery.

name: runtime-delivery-public-entry
description: Reply adapters consume the delivery public API rather than presentation or terminal delivery internals.

name: runtime-policy-no-effects
description: Policy classification must not read/write task state, perform environment probes or initiate execution and delivery.

name: runtime-acceptance-no-platform-effects
description: Settlement orchestration uses fixed effect ports; platform I/O and lifecycle ownership remain in the adapter.

name: runtime-candidate-public-entry
description: Reply adapters use the admitted candidate public API; internal implementation is not directly imported.

name: runtime-candidate-no-outer-execution-dependency
description: Candidate and turn contracts must not reverse-depend on the old outer execution owner, including types.

name: runtime-outcomes-no-execution-control
description: Outcome aggregation records original evidence only; it cannot invoke providers, mutate session tasks or restart work.

name: runtime-outcomes-public-entry
description: The original turn host uses the outcome public entry, not aggregate internals.

name: runtime-visible-delivery-no-execution-control
description: Delivery receipt preparation cannot run providers, restart work or mutate the authoritative task board.

name: runtime-terminal-delivery-no-legacy-control
description: Terminal delivery owns settlement and projection; original queue, continuation and gap I/O are fixed host ports, never a reverse import into legacy control.

name: runtime-validation-delivery-public-entry
description: Production validation and delivery matching use the delivery acceptance public entry; the legacy validation module is compatibility only.

name: runtime-validation-production-validators-public-entry
description: Production validation and delivery matching use the delivery acceptance public entry; the legacy validation module is compatibility only.

name: runtime-admitted-turn-public-main-entry
description: The main reply adapter consumes the execution public API; the legacy turn module is compatibility only.

name: runtime-admitted-turn-no-platform-control-imports
description: Admitted turn sequencing uses mandatory typed host capabilities for authoritative task, commercial slot, snapshot and session persistence effects; it cannot reverse-import the old orchestrator.

name: runtime-admitted-host-no-orchestration
description: The fixed host adapter binds existing effects and session recovery I/O; it cannot start another execution/provider loop.

name: runtime-reply-task-state-port
description: The main reply host delegates active-turn disposition and uses the state port for board access.

name: runtime-reply-composition-boundary
description: The main reply host uses the reply-turn composition for command, state and execution dependencies.

name: runtime-retired-entry-imports
description: Retired reply and execution adapters cannot be imported by runtime sources; callers use the current command/execution entry.

name: runtime-shared-model-no-business-control
description: Shared model admission has no task state, execution loop or delivery dependency. Tests may bind fixed host ports.

name: runtime-retired-admission-lifecycle
description: Shared model admission has one owner; retired execution lifecycle paths cannot re-enter the runtime.

name: runtime-state-public-entry-wiring
description: Task repository and mutations are private. Host consumers use state/index; narrow transcript/action adapters retain separate ownership.

name: runtime-state-public-entry-gateway
description: Task repository and mutations are private. Host consumers use state/index; narrow transcript/action adapters retain separate ownership.

name: runtime-state-public-entry-reply
description: Task repository and mutations are private. Host consumers use state/index; narrow transcript/action adapters retain separate ownership.

name: runtime-task-state-adapter-gateway
description: Migrated task-state consumers use state/index; the original board remains the sole lock and persistence adapter.

name: runtime-task-state-adapter-delivery
description: Migrated task-state consumers use state/index; the original board remains the sole lock and persistence adapter.

name: runtime-task-state-adapter-execution
description: Migrated task-state consumers use state/index; the original board remains the sole lock and persistence adapter.

name: runtime-command-candidate-public-entry
description: Command orchestration invokes candidates through execution/index; direct provider execution and private runner imports cannot return.

name: runtime-model-no-command-host-contracts
description: Shared model governance consumes runtime-owned contracts, never old command-host types or implementations.

name: runtime-delivery-no-command-host-contracts
description: Delivery consumes its narrow runtime data contract and cannot depend on command execution options.

name: runtime-execution-no-command-host-contracts
description: Execution consumes typed execution inputs, not command-host options or implementations.

name: runtime-no-legacy-execution-facades
description: Runtime implementations and wiring cannot loop through legacy execution facades; the registry compatibility test alone verifies shared identity.

name: runtime-state-no-legacy-board-facade
description: Runtime state authority cannot route through legacy task-board classification; only the compatibility fixture is exempt.
